articles.title: Egypt's Pharaohs Return to a Hero's Welcome After Historic World Cup Run
articles.summary: Hundreds of euphoric fans greeted Egypt's soccer team in el-Alamein after their deepest World Cup run ever. The Pharaohs reached the last 16 for the first time, and captain Mohamed Salah vowed a new era for Egyptian football.

articles.title: Forecasters Warn of a Potentially Historic El Niño—Here's Why It Matters
articles.summary: NOAA says the intensifying El Niño has an 81% chance of becoming 'very strong' by fall, rivaling the 1997-1998 event. It's already breaking records and could drive extreme weather and new global temperature highs.

articles.title: FCC Review of E-Rate Program Sparks Fears of Internet Funding Cuts for Schools
articles.summary: The FCC is scrutinizing the E-Rate program, which subsidizes internet for schools and libraries. Educators fear the review could lead to reduced funding, forcing districts to shoulder huge monthly costs.
